Amazon’s Zoox unit [issued a software recall](https://www.wionews.com/autonews/zoox-recalls-robotaxis-after-self-driving-crash-in-las-vegas-9043732) for its entire fleet of 270 driverless vehicles following a crash in Las Vegas. This follows a previous recall in April involving 258 units related to braking issues. In other autonomous vehicle safety developments, a pedestrian was killed on a California freeway by a Tesla operating in self-driving mode [on October 24](https://people.com/self-driving-tesla-kills-pedestrian-on-interstate-80-in-california-12191866).

The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) has [proposed new regulations](https://www.notateslaapp.com/news/4892/nhtsa-proposes-cyan-lights-for-driverless-cars-like-cybercab) requiring cyan exterior lighting on driverless vehicles to standardize visual identification and improve safety. Simultaneously, the NHTSA [proposed rules](https://www.basenor.com/blogs/news/nhtsa-proposes-new-rules-to-clear-path-for-tesla-cybercab) intended to facilitate the deployment of the Tesla Cybercab. Other industry expansions include Waymo [expanding robotaxi pickups](https://www.cedarnews.net/newstasks/1091617/us-waymo-launches-services-harry-reid-international/) at Harry Reid International Airport and Lucid Motors and Uber [announcing plans](https://insideevs.com/news/798932/lucid-gravity-robotaxi-houston-expansion-uber-nuro/) to bring robotaxis to Houston.

Advanced aviation and rail projects reached several procurement and regulatory milestones. The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) [cleared Beta Technologies' Alia](https://www.ainonline.com/futureflight) eVTOL aircraft for passenger demonstration flights and [approved market surveys](https://www.ch-aviation.com/news/173167-uss-beta-receives-faa-approval-for-a250-market-surveys) for the A250. Archer Aviation [announced the launch](https://aviationworld.in/archer-unveils-texas-air-taxi-networks-across-houston-dallas-and-austin/) of air taxi networks in Houston, Dallas, and Austin. In rail, Siemens Mobility [was awarded a $772 million contract](https://metrorailtoday.com/news/siemens-mobility-awarded-772-million-trainset-contract-for-california-high-speed-rail-project) to supply trainsets for the California High-Speed Rail project.

Defense and security sectors are prioritizing unmanned systems and counter-drone capabilities. The U.S. Air Force [conducted a flight test](https://www.aero-news.net/index.cfm?do=main.textpost&id=7627FA03-CC92-4B79-B30A-DCC323A1726A) where an F-22 pilot controlled an unmanned YFQ-44 aircraft. To protect critical infrastructure, NATO [deployed additional counter-drone protection](https://www.dronewatch.eu/nato-deploys-additional-counter-drone-protection-at-brussels-headquarters/) at its Brussels headquarters, while the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) [field-tested four sensors](https://shattered.io/counter-drone-technology-first-responders-dhs-nustl-saver-2026/) to assess detection capabilities for first responders.
